bio.text: Steve Hilton is the Republican nominee for governor of California in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He was a senior adviser to U.K. Prime Minister David Cameron from 2010 to 2012, then moved to California and co-founded a Silicon Valley political crowdfunding platform.
From 2017 to 2023 he hosted a weekly show on Fox News; he has also written books on decentralizing power in institutions.
According to his campaign website, he was born in London to Hungarian immigrants, attended Oxford, and taught at Stanford.

sources.title: Democrat Xavier Becerra and Republican Steve Hilton will face off in California governor's race
